documents.title: NMDFC FAQ - Term Loan Scheme for Minorities
documents.text: National Minorities Development and Finance Corporation (NMDFC) offers concessional credit to notified Minority Communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis, Jains). Term Loan scheme finances projects costing up to ₹30.00 lakh at 6% interest per annum. Income ceiling is ₹3.00 lakh per annum. Repayment tenure is up to 5 years.

documents.title: NMDFC FAQ - Virasat Scheme for Traditional Artisans
documents.text: Virasat Scheme is aimed at preserving traditional arts and crafts by providing concessional credit to minority artisans and weavers. Loan amount up to ₹10.00 lakh at 5% interest per annum for male artisans and 4% for female artisans. Repayment in 5 years.
